full_judgment: 7. Mr Faruque Ahmed, learned Counsel, appearing for the respondent, submitted that the High Court Division has committed no wrong in making the Rule absolute declaring that requisition has been initiated and started without any lawful authority; that the proceeding of Land Acquisition Case No. 1 of 1990-91 at the office of the respondent No.4, insofar it relates to the acquisition of the property of the writ-petitioners of Mouza Uzar Bhanga JL No. 165, Police Station Daudkandi, District-Comilla appertaining to RS Khatian No. 202 Plot No. 380 measuring 0.7 acre out of 0.14 acre of land as evidenced by Annexure-C, the writ petition is required to be declared to have been made without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
